source.method: Read-only queries against loaded editor world via Unreal MCP and viewport inspection.

conventions.actor_transforms: World cm, Pitch/Yaw/Roll in degrees, unitless scale. Component transforms are relative and retain signed scale.
conventions.actor_and_asset_bounds: World AABB for actors, asset-local AABB for mesh. Bounds are axis-aligned and can include overhang, hidden support or decorative mesh volume. Rounded to 0.001 cm here.
conventions.assembly_bounds: World AABB in metres, rounded to 0.01 m. Read each scope; a union may include gaps. Reuse sets are analysis-defined collections unless otherwise indicated. Editor group membership was not exposed by the read tools.
conventions.materials: Default asset slots and ordered actor component overrides. Null means no explicit override or no default path in that slot.
conventions.measurement_actor_ids: Canonical actor names for the live source world. The actor dictionary holds selected detail records; a measurement roster may also contain unsampled actors.

fortress_shell.selection: All seven great_tower and sixteen great_wall StaticMeshActors plus the outer gate's low turret wall gt_finished_Tower_wall_lp193. Main clock gate and hall are inside the resulting envelope.

fortress_and_bridge.selection: Fortress shell plus great_bridge_1170. Distant backdrop, rock dressing, Landscape and effects excluded.

with_near_silhouette.selection: Fortress and bridge plus bg_towers_Object711, bg_towers_Object712 and gt_finished_Tower_wall_lp208_34.

distant_castle_shells.selection: Ten bg_castle StaticMeshActors. Bounds are aggregate scenery spread, not an area of contiguous architecture.

plateau_recommendation.datum: Bridge-to-clock threshold at about +237 m in the source map, remapped to Astra's local Z zero.
plateau_recommendation.rationale: 585.48 x 472.33 m primary envelope plus about 22 m/26 m per edge when centered. The 598.52 x 487.39 m near-silhouette envelope leaves about 16 m/19 m per edge. Width and length are multiples of 15 m (two court bays or three hall floor modules). Reserve a terraced envelope with the main bridge spanning a cut, and increase edge allowance if the selected terrain needs it.

assemblies.name: Great bridge and deck build-up
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Reference the 241.8 m bridge mesh at the demo's scale for the blockout. Package the abutment and guard kit separately. Keep parapet and walkable dressing independent.
assemblies.evidence: Bridge shell and inset base are different meshes. The deck uses separate slabs and paired markers. The shell scale is (0.893867, 1, 1).
assemblies.bounds_scope: Bridge shell, inset base and sampled above-deck pieces. The shell controls X; the base extends a short distance past it in negative Y.

assemblies.name: Outer portcullis and turret pair
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Build a project Level Instance around the arch and side turrets. Keep the portcullis an independent gameplay actor if it needs to move.
assemblies.evidence: The arch and portcullis are independent, nonuniformly scaled mesh actors. Small wall faces, bands and two roofs build up the flank turrets.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Selected arch, grille and above-deck turret pieces. Lower embedded tower work and curtain walls are outside this scope.

assemblies.name: Outer curtain wall bays
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Reference the pack's complete wall bays. Set out runs by the intended seam and hand fit to tower corners. Use an array only for straight repeated runs.
assemblies.evidence: Same SM_Wall_01 asset forms battlements and lower wall as a single shell. Three placed bays have different scale or yaw.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Representative west and east segments. The union spans the gate gap.

assemblies.name: Retaining facade tiers
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Block out tier height and overlap with source bays, then hand fit support rock and wall returns. Keep the exposed upper profile separate from foundation coverage.
assemblies.evidence: An upper and lower actor pair at the same XY can mask grade changes. The east pair great_wall13 and great_wall13_796 repeats the asset with a 96.50 m Z offset.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Sampled central rear wall and double-stacked bays.

assemblies.name: Clock gate and mirrored facade
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Create one project Level Instance with a floor-line pivot. Reference the main shell directly. Preserve relative mirror and clock alignment, then fit a separate gameplay gate.
assemblies.evidence: The shell, small gate, twin door-detail pieces, plinths, statues and clock are independent. One facade half uses scale X = -1. The small gate is at uniform scale 0.830630.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Main entrance shell and recorded facade pieces. The shell controls the overall dimensions.

assemblies.name: Raised fountain court and connector
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Lay the structural grid and trim it at the portals. Keep top pavers, perimeter, fountain and cover independently editable. Give Astra's combat layout its own width and clearance pass.
assemblies.evidence: The slab asset is SM_Wall_05 rolled onto its side. A repeated slab pitch supports a separate 6 x 4 m paver layer, and the central fountain has a separate statue actor.
assemblies.bounds_scope: AABB of 90 contiguous structural slabs ground_tiles_Object22_675 through ground_tiles_Object22_764. Actor list includes samples, edge extensions and surface dressing outside that bound.

assemblies.name: Rear threshold and inner doors
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Use a project Level Instance for fixed surround and frame. Retain independent door leaves and fit them to Astra's collision and opening contract.
assemblies.evidence: The clock facade's mirrored door-detail pair repeats at the hall end. A smaller inset frame and leaf pair establishes the human-facing threshold.

assemblies.name: Terraced nave and interior room kit
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Author room bays as project Level Instances after the 5 m floor grid and aisle height are set. Fit ceiling, support pillars, doors and wall returns to each room.
assemblies.evidence: Distinct floor, tall walls, repeated ceiling, long pillars and end portal. Floor top bands around +240.43, +244.93 and +249.43 m.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Floor-only union of all 88 actors in InteriorStructural/Floor, including the rear exterior tile extension. The referenced enclosing meshes extend above it.

assemblies.name: Two axial stair flights
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Duplicate the unit-scale run as a project Level Instance with the rail kit and an entry-landing pivot. Resolve stairs and collision at full player scale before dressing.
assemblies.evidence: Four full modules and one half-length module per flight. The later flight follows the same x alignment. Separate rails and posts.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Two sampled flights, selected railing pieces and the space between them.

assemblies.name: Paired exterior side steps
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Duplicate the step mesh and fit the landings. Check the side drop and approach width before treating the route as playable.
assemblies.evidence: Twin step runs flank the central approach. Both use SM_BrickStairs.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Union of both runs, including the central gap.

assemblies.name: Crowned great tower
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Reference SM_Castle_01 as an exterior landmark shell. Set one scale and foot datum per tier, then fit ramps or playable interiors independently.
assemblies.evidence: The large main tower already includes buttressed massing and its open crown. Other placements rotate and scale the same mesh.

assemblies.name: Faceted turret and roof stack
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Author a reusable six-face tier with explicit yaw and seam overlap. Stack in a project Level Instance, with a roof and hand-fitted lower join.
assemblies.evidence: Three verified upper rings have six SM_SmallWall faces each at roughly 60 degree intervals with a separately scaled roof. Several lower faces extend below the recorded rings.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Upper three closed rings and roof only. A sample lower face reaches about +196.30 m and belongs to the broader facade context.

assemblies.name: Bridge rock and foundation seam
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Reference the two terrain meshes and dress the bridge/wall contacts by hand. Use overlap to bury structural seams. Keep rocks out of the combat lane.
assemblies.evidence: The two foundation-side rocks use one asset with separate transforms and overlaps. They sit below the outer gate and obscure the scale change.

assemblies.name: Clock gate damage and broken paving
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Reference the damaged variants for openings, edge loss and noncritical margins. Retain the walkable lane and control collision separately.
assemblies.evidence: Separate damaged trim, paving and column meshes sit alongside intact modules.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Union of sampled placements across different parts of the approach, not one assembly.

assemblies.name: Near spires and distant backdrop
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Reference near towers selectively and place distant massing beyond the play boundary or as backdrop. Budget these separately from terrain and routes.
assemblies.evidence: Two neighboring silhouette spires are near the fortress. The distant SM_CastleHuge copy at Y -1705 m is much larger and serves a separate scale layer.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Near silhouette sample only. The far castle actor is included as a reference outside the bound.

assemblies.name: Hall practical lighting props
assemblies.reuse_strategy: Reference the candle and chandelier Blueprint assets for dressing studies. Keep light and exposure tuning in the Ashen Keep environment pass.
assemblies.evidence: The candles and chandelier are Blueprint-based dressing. Their mesh components and attached roots are recorded.
assemblies.bounds_scope: Union of two example placements, not an architectural assembly.
